metric_definition: validation_auroc is the fixed evaluator's AUROC. Higher is better. The replay tracks this metric so sessions can be compared.
decision_recording: This session does not record a post-evaluation keep, discard, investigate, or failed decision. The text below is the proposal written before training.
running_best_definition: best_so_far_auroc is the running maximum validation AUROC among valid experiments, in chronological order. It is not a keep decision.
backtrack_definition: A backtrack is recorded when parent is an earlier experiment id, not the immediately previous experiment. The controller copies that parent's ml.py.
